description: Read Morse back from an on and off signal. Send one of bits (1 on and 0 off, one character per unit), durations (the on and off lengths in milliseconds, the first one on) or levels, such as the brightness of each camera frame or a light sensor reading, with rate in samples per second or as [milliseconds, level] pairs. The level at both ends counts as off and the unit is found, unless invert or unit_ms say otherwise; a message of one letter sent at another unit than 100 ms needs unit_ms. Answers text, the code read, unknown sequences, unit_ms, quality (the share of runs within a quarter unit of 1, 3 or 7 units) and inverted. At most 200,000 samples. Nothing is stored. No API key, no account and no sign up.

bits.description: One character per unit, 1 for on and 0 for off, such as 101010001110111011100010101.

durations.description: The on and off lengths in milliseconds in turn, the first one on.

invert.description: true when the low level means on, as with a screen that goes dark to signal; false when the high level does. Left out, it is found from the idle level at the ends.

levels.description: A reading per sample, such as [12, 200, 198, 15] with rate, or [milliseconds, level] pairs such as [[0, 12], [33, 200]].

rate.description: Samples per second for plain levels, such as 30 for a camera at 30 frames per second.

unit_ms.description: The unit the sender used, to fix it instead of finding it. With bits, the length of one character, 100 by default.

name: decode_blink
title: Read text from a blinking signal
